nodes.long_description:
The differences by difficulty level are as follows:

[Easy]
Designed for beginners or users who require a gentler introduction to the training. The goal post size is small, allowing players to focus on learning the gameplay mechanics and improving hand-eye coordination at a comfortable pace.

[Normal]
Provides the standard gameplay experience with a regular-sized goal post. This difficulty offers a balanced level of challenge suitable for most users while continuing to strengthen cognitive processing and reaction skills.

[Hard]
Intended for experienced users seeking a greater challenge. The goal post size is large, requiring faster decision-making, more accurate hand tracking, and improved cognitive response to successfully defend the goal.
nodes.short_description: It is a cognitive game for cognitive rehabilitation training to help rehabilitate people with cognitive decline and mild cognitive impairment, and is designed to provide more than one cognitive experience and training in the game. A cognitive rock-paper-scissors goalie game designed to be played by people with severe disabilities who have difficulty using controllers through hand tracking.

nodes.long_description: "Dive into the realm of realistic experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual reactions in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
